message: それぞれの秋

name: Synn
message: 「Oh no, I forgot something.」

name: Synn
message: 「As expected, nobody's left anymore.」
My muttered voice bounces off the blackboard and desks, echoing faintly.
Beyond the window blows a cold autumn wind. The window frames were rattling.
In the empty classroom, there is a warmth slightly different from loneliness.

name: Sacchin
message: 「Zzz, zzz, zzz.」

name: Synn
message: 「S-Sacchin's sleeping... So that's why it felt kind of warm.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Around Milady, it's always warm like spring.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Zzz, zzz, zzz.」
After chatting with everyone after school, she must have fallen asleep just like that. Sacchin is fast asleep, slumped face-down on her desk.

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, wake up, Sacchin? You're gonna catch a cold.」
I place a hand on Sacchin's shoulder and give her a gentle shake.

name: Sacchin
message: 「Zzz, zzz, mmm... N-Nana-chan. If you're naughty to me there, I... I can't take it~」

name: Synn
message: 「W-What kind of dream is she-huh!?」

name: Synn
message: 「She left all her textbooks stuffed inside her desk...」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Zzz... zzz...」

name: Synn
message: 「Good grief... You have to take them home properly and study, you know.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Mumble, mumble... I come to the academy to look for a bride, so it's fine~」

name: Synn
message: 「If you're gonna say that, wouldn't it be a groom?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Zzz... zzz... You were a candidate too, Synn-kun~」

name: Synn
message: 「I-It's in the past tense, huh.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Managing to hold a proper conversation while she's sleep-talking--just what I'd expect from Synn-sama.」

name: Synn
message: 「No, it's bad if she stays asleep. Come on, Sacchin... wake up.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Nn... nnn~? Nnn~~?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Fwaaah... Where~ am I~?」

name: Synn
message: 「Thank goodness, you finally woke up.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Achoo! Uuu~. I-It's cold~」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, autumn is getting deeper too.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Waaah, there's a warm futon right here~」

name: Synn
message: 「S-Sacchin?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Haaah... It's so warm... Mmh, feels so good... Mmh, mmnh...」
A soft, gentle scent. I was wrapped in Sacchin's soft body.
Hugged tight by Sacchin, I started warming up too.
I can even feel the curves of her body--Sacchin really is just a normal Girl, huh....

name: Synn
message: 「Wait, no, no!」
With Paqy's help, I somehow managed to wake Sacchin up properly.
